description.zh: 实例ID，您可调用DescribeDBInstances接口获取该参数的值。
description.en: The ID of the destination RDS instance. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to query for available instances.
The estimated data size of the source instance, in GB.
The address of the source MySQL instance.
The password for the specified user account. The password must be Base64-encoded.
The port number of the source MySQL instance.
The region ID. You can call the `DescribeRegions` operation to retrieve the latest list of available regions.
The ID of the source instance.

The platform type of the source instance.

- Set the value to `ECS`.
The port used for backup data transmission.
The user account for the source MySQL instance.
The path to the Xtrabackup tool on the source instance.

descriptions.zh: RDS MySQL原生复制实例数据导入任务预检查
descriptions.en: This operation validates the parameters and prerequisites for a data import task before you run the task.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds validate-import-task --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host 192.168.10.1 --port 3306 --stream-port 9999 --user myadmin --password UGFzc3dvcmQxMjMK --source-platform ECS --source-instance-id i-wz9ff3acy500io5wdf5s --xtrabackup-path /usr/local/bin/xtrabackup --db-instance-id rm-sdfljk1230000 --estimated-size 100 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rds ValidateImportTask --region cn-hangzhou --SourcePlatform ECS --User myadmin --XtrabackupPath '/usr/local/bin/xtrabackup' --EstimatedSize 100 --Port 3306 --StreamPort 9999 --Host '192.168.10.1' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SourceInstanceId 'i-wz9ff3acy500io5wdf5s' --DbInstanceId 'rm-sdfljk1230000' --Password UGFzc3dvcmQxMjMK
